description: khai composite content, the depression domain: the synergistic trap of a major depressive episode where anhedonia strips away restorative rewards, fatigue and psychomotor shutdown (melancholia) remove the energy to act, learned helplessness provides the cognitive evidence that action is futile, and worthlessness turns the resulting passivity into a permanent moral judgment, rendering the state inescapable.

khai.tagline: Depression as composite: the synergistic trap of a major depressive episode where anhedonia strips away restorative rewards, fatigue and psychomotor shutdown (melancholia) remove the energy to act, learned helplessness provides the cognitive evidence that action is futile, and worthlessness turns the resulting passivity into a permanent moral judgment.

card.wire: Attaches at Process, over five atoms it declares as dependencies. The root (process_depression.md) models a Major Depressive Episode not as a list of symptoms, but as a synergistic trap where the components actively prevent recovery. It delegates the atomic mechanisms to its dependencies: sadness handles the despair, anhedonia handles the blunted capacity, rumination handles the looping, self-esteem handles the baseline valuation, and body handles the fatigue. The composite adds only the read of the compound; it routes into three movements: learned helplessness, worthlessness, and melancholia. It is authored persona-architecture for a play, never a diagnosis of a real person.
card.issue: Three movements. Learned helplessness (Seligman): the cognitive-behavioral lock-in where the persona learns that their actions have no effect on their environment, leading to profound passivity. Worthlessness (Beck): the cognitive triad's self-judgment lock-in where the inability to recover is interpreted as a fundamental moral flaw. Melancholia (Nesse): the biological/evolutionary lock-in where severe psychomotor retardation and vegetative symptoms act as an extreme, dysfunctional energy-conservation mechanism.
card.require: Two altitudes hold the composite. The law: declared once in the project's Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root, so the read runs wherever its atoms are cast. The link, advisory: a persona running learned helplessness, worthlessness, or melancholia may link the movement under Projection, and the audit surfaces the ones left unnamed.
card.enforce: Structure is checked; coherence is judged. The kit verifies the floor: the law is declared, the composite's own members conform, and every hard link into the atoms resolves through a declared dependency. The boundary: this is the lock-in mechanism. Do not restate sadness or rumination; use the hard links to pull those atoms into the specific fusions that make up depression. It is character architecture for authoring, never a clinical assessment of a real person.
card.setup: Install the composite; its five atoms arrive as dependencies and their laws with them. Declare the law in the Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root. Stage the self-sealing nature of the syndrome -- the way the components defend each other against resolution.
